# Precision Terminal Logistics

Precision Terminal Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Precision Terminal Logistics is a neutral third-party operator that provides transloading, 3rd party terminal operations, industrial processing, storage & warehousing, transportation management & logistics services. They handle any product or commodity at dozens of u.s. locations and are a single source for transload solutions. Precision Terminal Logistics employs 62 people (+24.0% YoY, +12 people). Headquartered in Sewickley, Pennsylvania, United States, with an office in Albany.

## About

Precision Terminal Logistics (PTL) is a recognized industry leader in 3rd party terminal transload operations. Our national network of multimodal terminals handles a broad range of bulk commodities, with flexibility and thoughtful solutions that supports your supply chain and logistics strategies. 

Our value-added services include: • Terminal Transloading • Origin & Destination Transloading • Terminal Operations • Logistics • Site Development • Processing • Material Handling • Secure Commodity Storage • In-Plant Services • Staffing for Transload Terminal Operations 

As a neutral third-party operator, we develop optimized network services, selecting the best partners for your requirements. Hazardous and non-hazardous liquid and bulk products are handled by industry leading experts who know how to operate safely and efficiently. Our expanding and flexible terminal network is designed for maximum capability. PTL's agility provides the ability to add terminals wherever demand warrants.

PTL is in it for the long haul. It was formed by Anacostia Rail Holdings and Brown Brothers Harriman Capital Partners to operate, build, and acquire transloading terminals across the U.S. PTL has the resources to remain independent and strong as it continues to expand locations and capabilities.
